# appgatesdp_ringfence_rule (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) List of all ringfence actions in this Ringfence Rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action` (String) Applied action to the traffic.
- `direction` (String) The direction of the action
- `hosts` (List of String) Destination address. IP address or hostname.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the ringfence action.

Optional:

- `ports` (List of String) Destination port. Multiple ports can be entered comma separated. Port ranges can be entered dash separated. Only valid for tcp and udp subtypes.
- `types` (List of String) ICMP type. Only valid for icmp protocol.
